courses.overview: 從關係資料、路徑查詢與圖形一致性延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend relationship data, path queries and graph consistency to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 搜尋引擎索引與排序
related.why: 皆以索引縮小搜尋候選
related.whyEn: Both use indexes to narrow candidates
related.transfer: 皆以索引縮小搜尋候選
related.transferEn: Both use indexes to narrow candidates
related.difference: 圖查詢重關係路徑，文字排序重詞項證據
related.differenceEn: Graphs emphasize paths; text ranking emphasizes term evidence

place.name: CERN 科學運算城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「搜尋引擎索引與排序」共用的資料／元件介面；以「皆以索引縮小搜尋候選」指出能保留的條件。
針對「圖查詢重關係路徑，文字排序重詞項證據」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with search-engine indexing and ranking; use "Both use indexes to narrow candidates" to identify retained conditions.
For "Graphs emphasize paths; text ranking emphasizes term evidence", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 檢索增強生成知識平台
related.why: 圖譜可提供可追溯檢索資料
related.whyEn: Graphs can provide traceable retrieval data
related.transfer: 圖譜可提供可追溯檢索資料
related.transferEn: Graphs can provide traceable retrieval data
related.difference: RAG 還需檢查生成內容是否遵循證據
related.differenceEn: RAG additionally checks generated claims against evidence

courses.summary: 圖形資料庫知識網路從關係資料、路徑查詢與圖形一致性連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Graph-database knowledge networks connects interfaces, data and acceptance through relationship data, path queries and graph consistency. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「節點身分」到「交付圖譜」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect node identity to graph delivery, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 圖形資料庫把關係變成可查詢資料；本課借公開科學協作脈絡建立玩具知識圖，不宣稱 CERN 使用所選商用資料庫。
history.textEn: Graphs make relationships queryable; toy knowledge uses public scientific-collaboration context without claiming CERN uses the selected commercial database.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
